views.name: qcard_ledger_reconciliation
views.definition:
SELECT COALESCE(l.reference_action_id, l.reference_action_id_snapshot) AS action_id,
    l.room_id,
    (sum(l.amount_tetri) FILTER (WHERE (l.entry_type = 'card_purchase'::text)))::bigint AS card_sales_tetri,
    (sum(l.amount_tetri) FILTER (WHERE (l.entry_type = 'prize_allocation'::text)))::bigint AS initial_prize_allocation_tetri,
    (sum(l.amount_tetri) FILTER (WHERE (l.entry_type = 'growth_release'::text)))::bigint AS growth_released_tetri,
    (sum(l.amount_tetri) FILTER (WHERE (l.entry_type = 'growth_reserve'::text)))::bigint AS growth_reserve_tetri,
    (sum(l.amount_tetri) FILTER (WHERE (l.entry_type = 'platform_allocation'::text)))::bigint AS platform_allocation_tetri,
    (sum(l.amount_tetri) FILTER (WHERE (l.entry_type = ANY (ARRAY['manual_raise'::text, 'raise_call'::text]))))::bigint AS player_bets_tetri,
    (sum(l.amount_tetri) FILTER (WHERE (l.entry_type = 'prize_payout'::text)))::bigint AS main_prize_paid_tetri,
    (sum(l.amount_tetri) FILTER (WHERE (l.entry_type = 'side_pot_payout'::text)))::bigint AS side_pots_paid_tetri,
    (sum(l.amount_tetri) FILTER (WHERE (l.entry_type = 'uncalled_bet_refund'::text)))::bigint AS uncalled_refunds_tetri,
    (sum(l.amount_tetri) FILTER (WHERE (l.entry_type = 'unclaimed_prize'::text)))::bigint AS unclaimed_prize_tetri,
    (sum(l.amount_tetri) FILTER (WHERE (l.entry_type = 'round_remainder'::text)))::bigint AS round_remainder_tetri,
    (sum(l.amount_tetri) FILTER (WHERE (l.entry_type = 'refund'::text)))::bigint AS other_refunds_tetri,
    (sum(l.amount_tetri) FILTER (WHERE (l.entry_type = 'adjustment'::text)))::bigint AS adjustments_tetri,
    ((((COALESCE(sum(l.amount_tetri) FILTER (WHERE (l.entry_type = 'card_purchase'::text)), (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(sum(l.amount_tetri) FILTER (WHERE (l.entry_type = ANY (ARRAY['prize_payout'::text, 'growth_reserve'::text, 'platform_allocation'::text, 'unclaimed_prize'::text, 'round_remainder'::text]))), (0)::numeric)) - COALESCE(sum(l.amount_tetri) FILTER (WHERE ((l.entry_type = 'refund'::text) AND (o.entry_type = 'card_purchase'::text))), (0)::numeric)) +
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(sum(l.amount_tetri) FILTER (WHERE ((l.entry_type = 'refund'::text) AND (o.entry_type = 'card_purchase'::text))), (0)::numeric) >= COALESCE(sum(l.amount_tetri) FILTER (WHERE (l.entry_type = 'card_purchase'::text)), (0)::numeric)) THEN COALESCE(sum(l.amount_tetri) FILTER (WHERE (l.entry_type = ANY (ARRAY['growth_reserve'::text, 'platform_allocation'::text]))), (0)::numeric)
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END))::bigint AS card_fund_difference_tetri,
    (((COALESCE(sum(l.amount_tetri) FILTER (WHERE (l.entry_type = ANY (ARRAY['manual_raise'::text, 'raise_call'::text]))), (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(sum(l.amount_tetri) FILTER (WHERE (l.entry_type = ANY (ARRAY['side_pot_payout'::text, 'uncalled_bet_refund'::text]))), (0)::numeric)) - COALESCE(sum(l.amount_tetri) FILTER (WHERE ((l.entry_type = 'refund'::text) AND (o.entry_type = ANY (ARRAY['manual_raise'::text, 'raise_call'::text])))), (0)::numeric)))::bigint AS betting_fund_difference_tetri,
    ((COALESCE(sum(l.amount_tetri) FILTER (WHERE (l.entry_type = 'growth_release'::text)), (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(sum(l.amount_tetri) FILTER (WHERE (l.entry_type = 'growth_reserve'::text)), (0)::numeric)))::bigint AS growth_budget_accounted_tetri,
    (sum(l.amount_tetri) FILTER (WHERE ((l.entry_type = 'refund'::text) AND (o.entry_type = 'card_purchase'::text))))::bigint AS card_purchase_refunds_tetri,
    (sum(l.amount_tetri) FILTER (WHERE ((l.entry_type = 'refund'::text) AND (o.entry_type = ANY (ARRAY['manual_raise'::text, 'raise_call'::text])))))::bigint AS betting_refunds_tetri
   FROM (qcard_money_ledger l
     LEFT JOIN qcard_money_ledger o ON ((o.id = l.reversal_of_ledger_id)))
  GROUP BY COALESCE(l.reference_action_id, l.reference_action_id_snapshot), l.room_id;

views.name: qcard_seat_balance_reconciliation
views.definition:
SELECT s.room_id,
    s.user_id,
    s.display_name,
    s.seat_no,
    s.entry_stack_tetri,
    s.stack_tetri AS actual_stack_tetri,
    (
        CASE
            WHEN (s.entry_stack_tetri IS NULL) THEN NULL::numeric
            ELSE ((((s.entry_stack_tetri)::numeric - COALESCE(sum(l.amount_tetri) FILTER (WHERE (l.entry_type = 'card_purchase'::text)), (0)::numeric)) - COALESCE(sum(l.amount_tetri) FILTER (WHERE (l.entry_type = ANY (ARRAY['manual_raise'::text, 'raise_call'::text]))), (0)::numeric)) + COALESCE(sum(l.amount_tetri) FILTER (WHERE (l.entry_type = ANY (ARRAY['prize_payout'::text, 'side_pot_payout'::text, 'uncalled_bet_refund'::text, 'refund'::text]))), (0)::numeric))
        END)::bigint AS expected_stack_tetri,
    (
        CASE
            WHEN (s.entry_stack_tetri IS NULL) THEN NULL::numeric
            ELSE ((s.stack_tetri)::numeric - ((((s.entry_stack_tetri)::numeric - COALESCE(sum(l.amount_tetri) FILTER (WHERE (l.entry_type = 'card_purchase'::text)), (0)::numeric)) - COALESCE(sum(l.amount_tetri) FILTER (WHERE (l.entry_type = ANY (ARRAY['manual_raise'::text, 'raise_call'::text]))), (0)::numeric)) + COALESCE(sum(l.amount_tetri) FILTER (WHERE (l.entry_type = ANY (ARRAY['prize_payout'::text, 'side_pot_payout'::text, 'uncalled_bet_refund'::text, 'refund'::text]))), (0)::numeric)))
        END)::bigint AS difference_tetri,
    count(l.id) AS ledger_entries
   FROM (qcard_seats s
     LEFT JOIN qcard_money_ledger l ON (((l.room_id = s.room_id) AND (COALESCE(l.user_id, l.user_id_snapshot) = s.user_id))))
  GROUP BY s.room_id, s.user_id, s.display_name, s.seat_no, s.entry_stack_tetri, s.stack_tetri;
